sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 3604 of 2023
Applicant :- Birbal

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Vishwadeep Patel
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Vishwadeep Patel, learned counsel for applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 0123 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Sections 3, 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, Police Station- Adampur, District- Amroha, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

F.I.R. of the present case was lodged against applicant and his two family members and according to the F.I.R. the marriage of applicant was performed with the daughter of informant and applicant and his family members used to torture the daughter of informant for want of a motorcycle.
It is further stated in the F.I.R. that on 8.6.2022 informant received a call that at 2 p.m. in the afternoon applicant committed murder of his daughter.

Learned counsel for applicant submits entire allegation made against applicant is totally false and frivolous and applicant neither demanded any dowry nor he ever tortured the deceased, infact deceased committed suicide and marriage of applicant and deceased was a love marriage and informant was against their marriage and due to the harassment of the informant his daughter i.e.
Birbal vs State Of U.P. on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94182930/
1

committed suicide and thereafter informant on the basis of false allegation lodged F.I.R. of the present case and he is not having any criminal history and in the present matter, he is in jail since 10.6.2022.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that from perusal of post-mortem report it appears that deceased sustained several injuries and he died due to smothering and this fact clearly suggests that it is a case of homicidal death and not the case of suicide and as applicant is husband of the deceased, therefore, he should not be released on bail.
I have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record of the case.

Applicant is husband of the deceased and there is allegation against him that he tortured his wife due to want of dowry and his wife died under abnormal circumstances well within seven years of her marriage.

Post-mortem report of the deceased shows that she sustained several abrasion and contusion all over the body and according to the doctor she died due to smothering and, therefore,
post-mortem report of the deceased suggests that she was murdered and it is not a case of suicide.
Therefore, from the discussion made above, in my view applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the instant bail application is rejected.

Order Date :- 18.4.2023 Kumar Manish.
